arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Bennett argued Congress could have specified vehicle workers if desired.
Mr. Dvoretzky argued the FAA exempts only workers on moving instruments.
Justice Sotomayor noted cargo handlers are part of transportation commerce.
Ms. Bennett stated seamen and railroad employees share industry work duties.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The FAA exempts certain workers from mandatory arbitration. Southwest argues only those on moving vehicles qualify. Saxon claims all interstate commerce workers qualify.
